The interest-mixture prior and Sinkhorn assignment are otherwise unchanged, and exported digits remain hard choices from the combined assignment score. | This defines the tangent/Lorentz dimensions and coordinate convention, and explicitly links the Euclidean RQ quantities to the Lorentz points by a specified exp map, so the assignment is dimensionally well-defined without changing the mechanism or adding scores.
